verdict.rationale: Recurly's own docs show it emits webhooks. Credit invoices come with "webhook notifications", and the Engage partner-integration guide connects a Recurly account to another system via webhooks for real-time subscription event updates. That implies outbound HTTP callbacks to a configured endpoint, but the evidence is indirect and thin. Missing for 10: documented endpoint registration and management, an event-type catalog, payload/signature verification and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: each credit gets a clean record with a clear origin, full audit trail, and webhook notifications
